5min.usage: Immediate ramp warning, SCADA response, operator action in the next few minutes.
5min.technique_full: Naive persistence baseline corrected by recent ramp-rate, SCADA quality gate, and live resource driver movement.
5min.why_this_technique: At 5 minutes, the latest actual power and ramp-rate are usually more useful than a complex long-horizon weather model.

15min.usage: Correct the current dispatch block and detect fast intra-hour ramps.
15min.technique_full: Blend latest SCADA persistence with physical resource-to-power conversion and short residual correction.
15min.why_this_technique: At 15 minutes, both recent actual power and near-term resource movement matter.

2hour.usage: Support intraday schedule revision, reserve planning, and ramp-risk decisions later today.
2hour.technique_full: Convert short-horizon weather/resource drivers to power using physical PV/wind model, then apply learned residual distribution and event widening.
2hour.why_this_technique: At 2 hours, weather/resource drivers become more important than pure persistence.

40hour.usage: Day-ahead schedule, commitment, grid planning, and uncertainty communication.
40hour.technique_full: Use ensemble weather forecasts, physical conversion, quantile mapping, historical calibration and reliability checks.
40hour.why_this_technique: Day-ahead uncertainty is dominated by weather forecast uncertainty, so ensemble calibration is more relevant.
40hour.update_frequency: NWP issue cycle / hourly refresh if available

8day.usage: Weekly planning, low-renewable risk windows, maintenance planning and reserve outlook.
8day.technique_short: Scenario ensemble + analog days + climatology band
8day.technique_full: Generate scenario bands from medium-range ensemble, match historical analog days, and calibrate with climatology/regime statistics.
8day.why_this_technique: At 8 days, exact minute-level output is unrealistic; broad regime and scenario risk are more useful.

levels.description: Aggregate view at Pavagada pooling station or grid node. Best for grid scheduling, deviation and reserve planning.
levels.aggregation_logic: Sum actual_mw, possible_power_mw, schedule and forecast quantiles across hubs; apply correlation-aware widening for P10/P90.

levels.description: Whole plant view used by owner/operator for total output and business objective tracking.
levels.aggregation_logic: Sum all hubs and compare with plant schedule/local limit.

levels.description: Segment-level view to isolate which part of the plant is causing ramp, curtailment, data-quality or equipment issue.
levels.aggregation_logic: Sum the 5 blocks inside the selected hub; use hub-specific sensor and event metadata.

levels.description: Granular block-level view for diagnosing inverter/sensor/local power issues.
levels.aggregation_logic: Use direct block SCADA, block sensors and block forecast contribution.
